questions.stem: A 20-year-old primigravida was rushed to the OT for an emergency caesarean section. Her pregnancy was unplanned and she did not take folic acid supplementation prior to conception. Moreover, owing to the pandemic led lockdown and her remote residence, she could not adhere to regular antenatal care. The newborn was born with a neural tube defect and immediately shifted to the NICU. What is the least likely diagnosis?
